definitions.explanation: Describes a space that is unpleasantly small and tight, causing physical or psychological discomfort. Stronger and more negative than {狭|せま}い (narrow), emphasizing the oppressive feeling of being in a small space.

examples.japanese: {狭苦|せまくる}しい⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a cramped room.

examples.japanese: {狭苦|せまくる}しい⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧つらい。
examples.english: Working every day in a cramped office is tough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}すぎて、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{狭苦|せまくる}しく⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧しまった。
examples.english: There was too much luggage and the room became uncomfortably cramped.

notes:
USAGE:
An i-adjective ({狭苦|せまくる}しい → {狭苦|せまくる}しく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧). Formed from ⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧ (narrow) + ⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧ (painful/uncomfortable), this compound adjective adds an element of discomfort or oppressiveness that plain ⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧ lacks. Use {狭苦|せまくる}しい when emphasizing the unpleasant feeling, not just the physical dimensions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {狭苦|せまくる}しい⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: cramped room
- {狭苦|せまくる}しい⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧: confined space
- {狭苦|せまくる}しい⟦{車内|しゃない}→車内：06203_shanai⟧: cramped vehicle interior
- {狭苦|せまくる}しく⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel cramped
